capabilities_actually_used.access_path: Official Google AI, Firebase, Apps Script, and Colab documentation URLs

executive_delta: Repaired the multi-provider capability registry, preserved 19 capability IDs, downgraded unsupported certainty, and made Google free-tier routing conditional on live account, region, privacy, and billing checks.

facts.claim: Google's Gemini API rate-limit documentation says limits depend on the project usage tier and account state, can be viewed in AI Studio, and are not guaranteed.

Google's Gemini API terms describe content use and possible human review for Unpaid Services; for users in the EEA, Switzerland, or the UK, the Paid Services data-use terms apply to all Services even when access is free.
Firebase pricing lists Spark no-cost usage with no payment method needed and states that no-cost quotas apply at project level.
The Apps Script quota reference documents per-user quotas that reset 24 hours after the first request and warns that quotas may change without notice.

assumptions.validation: Human operator must inspect the project plan, billing link, API-key tier, and current quota view before any API dispatch.

risks.event: A provider changes free-tier quota, capacity, or model availability.
risks.trigger: AI Studio shows different limits or the service returns 429/503.
risks.mitigation: Read live limits at dispatch, use bounded backoff, and fall back without enabling billing.
